scripts.build: bun scripts/sync-manifest.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun scripts/copy-static.ts
scripts.package: bun run build && bun run stage-extension && web-ext build --source-dir build/extension --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest --filename ununique.xpi
scripts.web-ext:lint: bun run build && bun run stage-extension && web-ext lint --source-dir build/extension
